subject: Only use inputs in reactive functions ... but what about functions called by a reactive function

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Only use inputs in reactive functions ... but what about functions called by a reactive function
parts:
Is the rule about using inputs in reactive functions only static or dynamically scoped?

That is, if I have a non reactive function F which reads an input I (or calls reactive function H), 

is it OK to call F from a reactive function G, and will this set up the link between G->I and G->H?

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
